description: This is a C source file implementing a RAM disk driver for Zephyr OS, including data structures, initialization, read/write/ioctl operations, and device registration.

methods.name: lba_to_address
methods.description: Converts logical block address to memory address within the RAM disk buffer.

methods.name: disk_ram_access_status
methods.description: Returns the status of the RAM disk (always OK).

methods.name: disk_ram_access_read
methods.description: Reads data from the RAM disk at specified sector.

methods.name: disk_ram_access_write
methods.description: Writes data to the RAM disk at specified sector.

methods.name: disk_ram_access_ioctl
methods.description: Handles control commands for the RAM disk.

methods.name: disk_ram_init
methods.description: Initializes the disk device and registers it.
